snippet.title: Whispered Scrolls | Halloween Event 2026 Teaser | The Headless Horseman
snippet.description:
Keep to the lamplight. Something rides the Lamp Road after dark.

Halloween has come to Whispered Scrolls, a free fantasy MMO with skill-based action combat. The event runs until the end of November 3.

Play free: https://whisperedscrolls.com
Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/ERJmmVutFa

What's waiting for you
• Cursed Jack-o'-Lanterns fill the fields at night, and Hollow Scarecrows climb down from their posts by day.
• Collect Harvest Tokens and trade them at the Harvest Fair in Hearthmoor for the Harvest Scarf, Mantle, Hood and Cloak.
• Hunt for the rare Jack-o'-Lantern Headpiece and Straw Scarecrow Hat.
• At dusk the Headless Horseman rides out of the mist. It's a dangerous world boss, so bring friends, and bring it down before dawn to earn its mount and scythe and the title Horseman's Bane.
• Every town is dressed for Halloween, and the nights are darker, so lamps and torches matter more than ever.

Every shot in this teaser was captured in-engine.
